propositions: Mutation shard enforcement modes (advisory, ratchet, strict) must be declared in a canonical manifest and validated to exclude duplicate or invalid configuration.
Fresh base/head archives without persisted verdict cache must be used for ratchet and strict evaluation, with per-shard 30-minute job limits and pinned mutmut 3.7.0 runtime.
Selector must map changed source, test, support files and global inputs to shards, report unmatched Python tests, handle renames/deletions, and emit deterministic JSON for targeted or all-shard runs.

Ratchet mode must preserve unchanged legacy survivors and report-only no-tests while blocking killed-mutant regressions, new survivors, and timeouts; strict mode must require every mutant killed or individually fingerprinted.
Documentation must specify phased promotion policy, evidence requirements, manifest authority, and absence of legacy score tables; a contract test must validate these requirements.
